# omni-equations

> Our equation library: 67 concepts as dependency-free Rust, with their definitions, laws and recorded spec rows; free for the community.

Setup: `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-equations && cd omni-equations && python3 -I tools/verify.py . --only hamming,fib,gcd,mod_inverse,ntt | tail -1` (expect: "pass": true).
Status: pre-alpha, under development — read STATUS.md before relying on a number.
Licence: Apache-2.0 (code) + CC BY 4.0 (documents).
